name: Azar Stronghammer
summary: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Azar Stronghammer guides new dwarven paladins. After completing his own training in the Holy Light, he sends promising recruits to Ironforge for further instruction.

sections.title: A Guide in the Cold
sections.body: Azar Stronghammer guides new dwarven paladins at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Humans are often linked to the great cathedrals, yet the dwarves of Khaz Modan have embraced the virtues of the Holy Light. Azar has mastered his own martial and spiritual vows, and helps newly inducted paladins find their footing on Dun Morogh's freezing slopes. When a novice shows dedication and spiritual maturity, he sends them up the mountain path to Ironforge. There they can study under veteran champions such as Tiza Battleforge.

faq.answer: Azar Stronghammer trains dwarven paladins at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He guides them through their earliest instruction before sending promising recruits to Ironforge for further study.

faq.q: Where can Azar Stronghammer be found?
faq.answer: You can find Azar Stronghammer inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, among the snowy hills of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What training does he provide to young paladins?
faq.answer: Azar teaches novices fundamental paladin martial arts and spells. When an apprentice is ready for the trials of the Tome of Divinity and its sacred rites of resurrection, he directs them to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is a paladin trainer stationed at a distillery?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew Distillery is a natural gathering place for Kharanos's defenders and mentors. Dwarven life brings civic duties, fellowship, and stout drink together, and the distillery lies at the heart of the village's social life and defense.

angles.text: As a dwarven paladin beginning in Dun Morogh, you can learn from Azar before he directs you to Ironforge to earn the sacred Tome of Divinity.
Azar shows how the dwarves of Khaz Modan embrace the Holy Light. For you, devotion to holy righteousness belongs alongside a warm hearth and a mug of Thunderbrew.
